entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> Lord, you were good to your land: changing the fate of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: The wrongdoing of your people had forgiveness; all their sin had been covered. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: You were no longer angry: you were turned from the heat of your wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Come back to us, O God of our salvation, and be angry with us no longer.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Will you go on being angry with us for ever? will you keep your wrath against us through all the long generations?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Will you not give us life again, so that your people may be glad in you?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Let us see your mercy, O Lord, and give us your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: ¶I will give ear to the voice of the Lord; for he will say words of peace to his people and to his saints; but let them not go back to their foolish ways.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Truly, his salvation is near to his worshippers; so that glory may be in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Mercy and faith have come together; righteousness and peace have given one another a kiss.

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Faith comes up from the earth like a plant; righteousness is looking down from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: The Lord will give what is good; and our land will give its increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness will go before him, making a way for his footsteps.
